```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)   
```

```{r import-csv}
library(readr)                          
enroll <- read_csv("enrollment.csv")    
head(enroll)                            
dim(enroll)                             
```

The enrollment file loaded with `r nrow(enroll)` rows and `r ncol(enroll)` columns.

```{r import-excel}
library(readxl)                         
demo <- read_excel("institutional.xlsx", sheet = "Demographics") 
head(demo)                              
dim(demo)                             
```

The Demographics sheet loaded with `r nrow(demo)` rows and `r ncol(demo)` columns.
